```{=html}
<div class="resource-page start-page">
  <section class="resource-hero start-hero" aria-labelledby="start-title">

      <p class="eyebrow">STT-1100</p>
      <h1 id="start-title">How to move through the course</h1>
      <p>The course is built as a data science pathway. Each module starts with targeted readings, immerses you in a guided adventure, then leads you to produce a personal trace: report, graph, cleaned dataset, function, video or dashboard.</p>
      <div class="resource-actions" aria-label="Quick access">
        <a class="home-action home-action--primary" href="modules.html">See modules</a>
        <a class="home-action" href="#first-session">First session</a>

      </div>
    </div>

      <div><span>1</span><p>Read and orient yourself</p></div>
      <div><span>2</span><p>Check the readings</p></div>
      <div><span>3</span><p>Complete the adventure</p></div>
      <div><span>4</span><p>Complete the challenge</p></div>
      <div><span>5</span><p>Consolidate elsewhere</p></div>
      <div><span>6</span><p>Keep a trace</p></div>
    </div>

  <section class="resource-section resource-split" id="first-session" aria-labelledby="first-session-title">
    <div>
      <h2 id="first-session-title">Before the first session</h2>
      <p>The first step is simple: have the right access, the right tools and a clear idea of where to find instructions.</p>
      <ol class="clean-steps">
        <li>Install or check R, RStudio, Quarto and Git.</li>
        <li>Sign in to Brio for official instructions, dates and submission rules.</li>
        <li>Sign in to GitHub, then use the repository or template requested when the module specifies it.</li>
        <li>Open the current module page and locate the learning plan, adventure, exercises and challenge.</li>
        <li>Test a first Quarto render as soon as a <code>.qmd</code> file is provided or created.</li>
      </ol>
    </div>
    <div class="resource-compact-list" aria-label="Starting landmarks">
      <article class="resource-compact"><h3>Brio</h3><p>Brio remains the reference for dates, official instructions, submissions and course announcements.</p></article>
      <article class="resource-compact"><h3>Course Site</h3><p>The site is for working: modules, readings, mini-tests, adventures, exercises, challenges, data and resources.</p></article>
      <article class="resource-compact"><h3>GitHub</h3><p>GitHub is used to retrieve some templates, track versions and submit a trace when requested.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="module-path-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="module-path-title">The path of a module</h2>
      <p>A module is not just a list of pages. It is a complete cycle: understand, practise, produce, consolidate, then keep a trace of what you learned.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="journey-map" aria-label="Pedagogical pathway of a module">
      <article class="journey-step">
        <span class="journey-step__number">01</span>
        <span class="journey-step__icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-book"></i></span>
        <h3>Readings</h3>
        <p>The readings give you useful language, concepts and functions before you open the code.</p>
        <span class="journey-step__output">Starting point</span>
      </article>
      <article class="journey-step">
        <span class="journey-step__number">02</span>
        <span class="journey-step__icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-ui-checks"></i></span>
        <h3>Mini-test</h3>
        <p>The formative mini-test quickly checks key ideas. It helps identify what should be reread before the adventure.</p>
        <span class="journey-step__output">Self-diagnosis</span>
      </article>
      <article class="journey-step">
        <span class="journey-step__number">03</span>
        <span class="journey-step__icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-compass"></i></span>
        <h3>Adventure</h3>
        <p>The adventure is the guided classroom practice. It stages a role, data and a concrete problem.</p>
        <span class="journey-step__output">Guided immersion</span>
      </article>
      <article class="journey-step">
        <span class="journey-step__number">04</span>
        <span class="journey-step__icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-flag"></i></span>
        <h3>Challenge</h3>
        <p>The challenge extends the adventure in the same universe, with more autonomy and an assessed deliverable.</p>
        <span class="journey-step__output">Short production</span>
      </article>
      <article class="journey-step">
        <span class="journey-step__number">05</span>
        <span class="journey-step__icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-tools"></i></span>
        <h3>Exercises</h3>
        <p>The exercises consolidate technical habits in other contexts and with other datasets.</p>
        <span class="journey-step__output">Independent practice</span>
      </article>
      <article class="journey-step">
        <span class="journey-step__number">06</span>
        <span class="journey-step__icon" aria-hidden="true"><i class="bi bi-journal-check"></i></span>
        <h3>Portfolio trace</h3>
        <p>The final trace tells you what to keep: files, decisions, corrected errors and reusable learning.</p>
        <span class="journey-step__output">Working memory</span>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" id="where-to-go" aria-labelledby="where-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="where-title">If you do not know where to go</h2>
      <p>The site is organized by use. Start with the situation that best matches what you need right now.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="course-flow" aria-label="Quick navigation through the site">
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">1</span><h3>I am starting a module</h3><p>Open the module page, then follow the learning plan in order.</p><a href="modules.html">See modules</a></article>
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">2</span><h3>I am looking for a resource</h3><p>Use the resources page to find books, packages, data, supports and AI help.</p><a href="ressources.html">See resources</a></article>
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">3</span><h3>I am technically stuck</h3><p>Return to the toolkit to find R, Quarto, GitHub and debugging routines.</p><a href="boite_outils.html">Open the toolkit</a></article>
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">4</span><h3>I am preparing a submission</h3><p>Reread the challenge instructions, render the document and check the trace before submitting on Brio.</p><a href="defis.html">See challenges</a></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="roles-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="roles-title">Three pieces, three functions</h2>
      <p>Adventures, challenges and exercises do not serve the same purpose. Distinguishing them prevents you from looking for the wrong answer in the wrong place.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="principle-grid">
      <article class="principle-card start-principle-card">
        <span class="card-kicker">Adventure</span>
        <h3>Learn through a situation</h3>
        <p>You are guided through a narrative context: a role, someone to help, data to understand and choices to justify.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="principle-card start-principle-card">
        <span class="card-kicker">Challenge</span>
        <h3>Show your autonomy</h3>
        <p>The challenge remains connected to the adventure, but asks for a shorter, more focused and assessed personal production.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="principle-card start-principle-card">
        <span class="card-kicker">Exercises</span>
        <h3>Stabilize habits</h3>
        <p>The exercises stand apart. They use other contexts to practise without depending on the challenge narrative.</p>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="modules-path-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="modules-path-title">The 10-module pathway</h2>
      <p>Each module adds a visible skill. The path moves from a first reproducible report toward more autonomous productions: collaboration, ethics, automation, prediction and dashboarding. In Fall 2026, Module 2 is prepared through independent work during the week of September 7, then worked through in class on September 14.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="module-arc-grid" aria-label="Detailed module pathway">
      <a class="module-arc-card" href="module_01/index.html">
        <span class="module-arc-card__number">1</span>
        <span class="module-arc-card__body"><span class="module-arc-card__stage">Start</span><span class="module-arc-card__title">Data Science Dive</span><span class="module-arc-card__text">Get started with R, RStudio, Quarto and a first weather dataset.</span><span class="module-arc-card__product">Product: mini Quarto report.</span></span>
      </a>
      <a class="module-arc-card" href="module_02/index.html">
        <span class="module-arc-card__number">2</span>
        <span class="module-arc-card__body"><span class="module-arc-card__stage">Organize</span><span class="module-arc-card__title">GitHub and Data Visualization</span><span class="module-arc-card__text">Structure a repository, import an Excel file and create readable charts.</span><span class="module-arc-card__product">Product: logbook and GitHub report.</span></span>
      </a>
      <a class="module-arc-card" href="module_03/index.html">
        <span class="module-arc-card__number">3</span>
        <span class="module-arc-card__body"><span class="module-arc-card__stage">Tell</span><span class="module-arc-card__title">Categories in All Their Forms</span><span class="module-arc-card__text">Clean strings, count categories and build a journalistic angle.</span><span class="module-arc-card__product">Product: reproducible Quarto article.</span></span>

        <span class="module-arc-card__body"><span class="module-arc-card__stage">Clean</span><span class="module-arc-card__title">Factors and Data Cleaning</span><span class="module-arc-card__text">Diagnose errors, recode variables and document decisions.</span><span class="module-arc-card__product">Product: clean data and cleaning log.</span></span>

        <span class="module-arc-card__body"><span class="module-arc-card__stage">Explore</span><span class="module-arc-card__title">Explore and Understand Relationships Between Variables</span><span class="module-arc-card__text">Compare variables, visualize associations and interpret without overclaiming.</span><span class="module-arc-card__product">Product: argued exploratory report.</span></span>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="progression-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="progression-title">Progression in four phases</h2>
      <p>Difficulty increases by layers. Technical skills come back, but the level of autonomy and communication responsibility increases.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="phase-track" aria-label="Skill progression">
      <article class="phase-card"><span>Modules 1-3</span><h3>Enter the craft</h3><p>Produce reproducible reports, understand data structure and turn analysis into a message.</p></article>
      <article class="phase-card"><span>Modules 4-6</span><h3>Make work reliable</h3><p>Clean, document, join tables and collaborate without losing reproducibility.</p></article>
      <article class="phase-card"><span>Modules 7-8</span><h3>Act responsibly</h3><p>Visualize without misleading, protect data and automate information collection carefully.</p></article>
      <article class="phase-card"><span>Modules 9-10</span><h3>Communicate uncertainty</h3><p>Make a first prediction, discuss bias and deliver an analysis others can consult.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="immersion-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="immersion-title">Data Science Immersion</h2>
      <p>The modules place you in the roles that structure a data science project. The goal is to learn technical gestures while understanding who produces, protects, analyzes and communicates data.</p>
    </div>
    <figure class="workflow-figure">
      <img src="autre_materiel/roles-science-donnees/whole-game.png" alt="Full data science project cycle: import, tidy, transform, visualize, model and communicate.">
    </figure>
    <div class="role-grid">
      <article class="role-card"><h3>Data Engineer</h3><p>Make reliable, accessible and well-structured data available.</p></article>
      <article class="role-card"><h3>Data Owner</h3><p>Guarantee governance, quality, access and confidentiality.</p></article>
      <article class="role-card"><h3>Statistician</h3><p>Model phenomena, quantify uncertainty and formulate careful conclusions.</p></article>
      <article class="role-card"><h3>Data Scientist</h3><p>Turn data into analyses, products, models or recommendations.</p></article>
      <article class="role-card"><h3>Data Analyst</h3><p>Produce indicators, visualizations and analyses useful for decision-making.</p></article>
      <article class="role-card"><h3>Data Journalist</h3><p>Tell verifiable and visual stories from documented data.</p></article>
      <article class="role-card"><h3>Freelancer</h3><p>Intervene on part of the cycle with targeted and adaptable expertise.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="tools-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="tools-title">Tools to Install</h2>
      <p>These tools form the minimal course environment.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="resource-hub-grid compact-hub">
      <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>R</h3><p>The language used to import, transform, visualize and analyze data.</p><div class="resource-link-list"><a href="https://www.r-project.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span>R Project</span><span>Official download.</span></a></div></article>
      <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>RStudio</h3><p>The working environment used to write code, manage projects and produce reports.</p><div class="resource-link-list"><a href="https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span>RStudio Desktop</span><span>Download from Posit.</span></a></div></article>
      <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>Quarto</h3><p>The system that turns .qmd files into HTML reports, notes and web pages.</p><div class="resource-link-list"><a href="https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span>Quarto get started</span><span>Installation and first document.</span></a></div></article>
      <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>Git and GitHub</h3><p>Version-control tools used to track changes and submit some work.</p><div class="resource-link-list"><a href="https://git-scm.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span>Git</span><span>Local installation.</span></a><a href="https://docs.github.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span>GitHub Docs</span><span>Official documentation.</span></a></div></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section resource-split" aria-labelledby="routine-title">
    <div>
      <h2 id="routine-title">Minimal Routine</h2>
      <p>Each work session should follow a simple routine. It reduces errors and keeps the project reproducible.</p>
      <ol class="clean-steps">
        <li>Open the right project in RStudio.</li>
        <li>Read the learning-plan card linked to the task of the day.</li>
        <li>Run code in small sections and check the outputs.</li>
        <li>Render the Quarto document to catch errors.</li>
        <li>Keep only useful files, then commit if the module requires it.</li>
      </ol>
    </div>
    <div class="resource-compact-list" aria-label="Help during the course">
      <article class="resource-compact"><h3>When you are stuck</h3><p>Reproduce the error, read the full message, then isolate the smallest possible example.</p></article>
      <article class="resource-compact"><h3>With the course AI</h3><p>Open <a href="ia.html">AI and Help</a> or <a href="https://chatgpt.com/g/g-682d165f32e881918633affa3fe9dfd6-gpt-stt-1100" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GPT STT-1100</a>. Ask: <em>Here is my error, minimal code and expected result. Help me find the likely cause, then give me one check I can do myself.</em></p></article>
      <article class="resource-compact"><h3>Before submitting</h3><p>Render the file, reread the conclusions and check that the deliverable answers the challenge.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>
```
